svg.aria-label: Teaching calculations and simulations. A: higher NA narrows Gaussian central profiles for two emitters separated by 0.30 μm. B: coarse sampling loses detail even with unchanged optics. C: SNR with photon noise alone or added background and read noise. D: 10,000 seeded Poisson exposures with mean count 100.
